content.text:
Two wake-ups at 19 months is common and usually means Remy hasn't yet learned to resettle without you, so the go-to move is to go to him but hold back the full comfort response — pat and a quiet word, then leave before he's asleep, so he practices linking sleep cycles on his own.

Want the full night-by-night plan for Remy? Reply YES and I'll send it.
